title: Irish Charred Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew with a charred twist, perfect for a chilly evening. The zesty flavor adds a delightful kick.
instructions: Season the beef with zesty seasoning blend, salt, and pepper.
Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the oil and sear the beef until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously. Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 1-1.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Return the browned beef to the pot and stir to combine. Serve hot.
